name: capitalloop-monorepo
description: Private-only multiplayer Monopoly-style board game inspired by Richup.io

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n SHARED,SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @capitalloop/shared" "npm run dev -w @capitalloop/server" "npm run dev -w @capitalloop/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @capitalloop/shared && npm run typecheck -w @capitalloop/server && npm run typecheck -w @capitalloop/client
